Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, let's eat here. Looks nice and peaceful.
Want to eat our lunch here？
I made it Japanese-style. What do you think？
Awesome, home-style cooking! Let's dig in!
Ta-da! I went with Japanese style!
Sweet, you can't beat Japanese food. Let's dig in!
Here's your lunch. I worked pretty hard on it, you know.
Whoa, awesome. Looks like a Western diner.
Western-style lunch today. I focused on the colors... What do you think？
Whoa, it almost looks too good to eat. ...Not stopping me, though!
I went with Chinese today. Hope you don't mind？
Not at all, love it! Let's dig in!
It's Chinese today. Eat up, okay？
Here's your lunch. I seasoned it with lots of love▼
Having you eat my lunch... No matter how often I do it, I still get nervous.
Really？ It looks great, though. Let's dig in!
So, couple tradition... Want me to feed you？
Don't be shy, open wide. Say ahh~
Hmph. Fine, I won't do it anymore then.
Turning me down, huh？ Hmph, fine, be that way.
I'm not accepting that! Now, say ahh~
Oh well. You've always been such a shy boy.
Hmph, is that so... Fine, I'll just eat it myself.
Thanks for the food! It was so good, I don't know what to say.
Aw, you make me so happy when you love it that much!
Thanks for the food. Your cooking really is the best, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Really？ Then I guess I have to aim higher than 'the best' from now on.
Yeah, that was great. Thanks for the food.
Glad you liked it! I'll make it again, okay？
Thanks for the food. Um... it was interesting.
Is that supposed to be a compliment？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... Still a bit rough around the edges, maybe.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... She handles it all pretty smoothly.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... She's really gotten good.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... Good enough for a boyfriend to brag about.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... Doesn't even feel like an amateur made it.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... She could totally teach other people by now.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... It's on par with a first-class chef.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... Feels like something from a three-star restaurant.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... This is seriously world-class.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills... The best in human history!)
So, what do you want to eat next time？ I'm ready to take your order!
I'm in the mood for Japanese.
Not sure what genre, but... ※ Unused
Order received! That's actually my specialty♪
Got it. I think I can handle that fine.
Sure. But... I'm not super confident, so don't get your hopes up, okay？
...Truth is, I've never made that before. But I'll do my best, okay？
First time here, huh？ Hope it turns out to be a hit.
The food here was really good, wasn't it？ I'm pretty fond of this place.
Really？ Then coming here was definitely the right call.
Well, let's just head inside for now.
We've practically become regulars here, haven't we？
Yeah, like 'give us the usual, boss!' Haha.
You really like this place, don't you...？ No, I don't mind at all.
Not feeling it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Well, let's just stick with it for today.
How's it looking？ Decided what you want yet？
I'm so hungry, it's hard to choose...
Hmm... what should I do？ I don't think I can eat a ton, so...
●'ll have the ▲生成選択肢１▲, what about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Me？ Let's see... How about this one？
The ▲生成選択肢１▲, huh... Sounds good.
The ▲生成選択肢２▲, got it. I'll call the waiter over.
The ▲生成選択肢２▲, right. Looks delicious.
I'd like to see a different style
I liked the style from when we met
Huh？ That's totally unfair! Honestly, you're impossible.
I'd kind of like to see how your hair was when we met.
Really？ Sure, why not, if that's what you'd like.
I'd love to, but with my hair this length... Can you wait a bit？
Sure. I'll look forward to it.
I'll think about it, but... hmmm.
(She doesn't seem into it. Too bad.)
I was just thinking I'd like to see you in a different style.
Sure! Why don't we look through a magazine and decide together？
Really？ Hmm, but I actually like it the way it is now...
I really like this hairstyle. I hope you keep it for a while.
Really？ I'm glad. I really liked it too.
Is that so...？ I was kind of thinking of changing it, though.
How about trimming it a bit？
How about cutting it all short？
Wouldn't that be pretty much the same as it is right now？
True. Sorry, keep it like that then.
You like that better？ Hmm... Maybe I'll switch it up then.
Sweet! I know it'll look great on you.
You know, changing up our hair isn't that simple for a girl？
Yeah, you're right... Sorry for saying something weird.
About that accessory you're wearing today...
That thing in your hair looks really nice.
I just thought that necklace is perfect for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I was just thinking that thing on your wrist looks great.
That ring, it's just perfect for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Those glasses really suit you. Looking good.
Really？ Even if you're just flattering me, thanks. Hehe.
I mean it! It really looks great on you.
That hair accessory... doesn't quite work.
Those earrings... maybe they don't really suit you？
That necklace... might not be the best.
That thing on your wrist... sorry, doesn't really suit you.
That ring might not be the best on you.
Those glasses you're wearing... don't really feel like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Oh, really...？ Guess I'll stop wearing it for a while.
By the way, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how do you usually decide what to wear？
The cut really is important after all.
Then... what kind of cut do you like, by the way？
I see, so that's it. Well... look forward to our next date then.
Is that so？ But it'll depend on how I feel that day.
Color really changes things, doesn't it？ What kind of colors do you like？
Let's see... Bright and warm, I think.
Bright, cool colors sound good to ●, I guess.
Hmm, darker and warm, I think.
Hmm... Dark, cool colors sound good, maybe.
So that's what you like. Maybe I'll match your taste on our next date.
I'll be looking forward to it!
I see... That's a little different from what I like.
A neat, clean look suits ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ best, after all.
So you like what I'm wearing right now, then？
I guess so... Yeah. I think it really suits you.
Fufu, alright. Maybe I'll try that for our next date.
It'll definitely look great on you!
Sorry... Lately, that style just doesn't feel right for me.
I see. Sorry for bringing it up, then.
Hey, how about changing what you call ●？
Sure, but... what do you want me to call you？
Don't you like what I call you？ I actually really like it, though...
I see. Then I won't push it.
...I think what I call you now is better. Any other ideas？
I'd really like you to call me ▲新主人公▲.
How does that sound...？ I hope you like it.
I'd love it if you called me ▲新主人公▲.
So that's what you wanted me to call you？ Hmm, you should've told me sooner.
Sounds good to me！ It's kind of cute. I've gotten fond of it already.
Hmm... Maybe we should just leave it the way it is？
Yeah, I guess so. Shame, though...
I was thinking about changing what I call you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Is that so？ What are you gonna call me, then？
Oh, really？ I'm fine with how things are now, though.
I see... I'll leave it, then.
Can I call you ▲生成選択肢５▲？
That's a little... Could you pick something else？
Can I call you ▲生成選択肢５▲？
Of course you can. I think I like that one, too.
I'd really like to call you ▲生成選択肢５▲.
Guess I have no choice. Special permission granted！
Oh... that's pretty good！ I really like it too.
That's enough for now. Let's leave it, okay？
I've been thinking about changing my hair... Will you help me pick？
You don't have to change it
Do you like my hair right now？ In that case, I'll keep it as is.
Yeah. I think it's best the way it is.
What kind of style would look good...？ Which one do you like？
Going by ●'s taste... Yeah, probably around here.
Want to pick from around here？
Sure. Let me know what you think.
Let's pick one from around here.
I see, so this is what you like. Okay, let's pick one out！
Yeah, which one should it be？
Why don't we pick from around here？
Sure thing. Your big sis looks good in anything, after all.
Now, which one should I pick...
Hmm, would that look good on me？
So this is the kind you like？
I don't know if I can pull that off...
Hmm, there are so many, it's hard to choose.
For me... maybe something like this.
If I go with this, I'll have to cut my hair.
My hair isn't long enough, so not right away, maybe.
I like it too... Yep, it's decided!
I'm sure it'd look great on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hey, so what should we do about the color？
Hair color really changes your whole look, huh.
Next up... we have to decide on the color.
You're changing your hair color too？
Not necessarily, but I've got to consider it. That's all part of the style, right？
Got it. Then ●'ll think about it with you.
Will you help me pick the color too？
Sure. Wonder what color would be best...
Don't worry, I'll take it seriously.
A natural look might be really nice.
That color, huh... Well, if you say so...
You can totally pull it off, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Then I'll unveil the new me sometime soon. Stay tuned!
I'll be looking forward to it.
Thank you for waiting. Please enjoy your meal.
Looks delicious. Well then... let's eat.
This is really good. Hey, you try some too？
You make it look so good. Now you've got me wanting to try some too.
I'm kind of surprised... I didn't expect it to be this delicious.
That was delicious. We should come back again.
Mm, it gets a passing grade.
Well... I feel like they could make this a lot tastier.
Bad choice... It had something in it I really don't like.
(She's so happy... Glad I picked a good place.)
(Something ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't like... I had no idea.)
I'm totally satisfied. It was so good, I might have let my guard down and overeaten？
It was delicious, and the portion was just right♪
It was good, but maybe we should've ordered a bit more.
I ate till I was full, but... the flavor could've been a little better.
It was plenty filling, but the flavor was a little off.
There wasn't enough food, and the flavor... Total miss, wasn't it？
We got to take a nice break. I'm glad it was such a calm, relaxing place.
Hmm... It was kind of hard to relax in there, wasn't it？
The interior was so stylish. I couldn't help staring a bit.
If only the atmosphere had been a little nicer.
This place has a great reputation right now, doesn't it♪
No way, this is amazing... Time to dig in.
This is... not really to my taste.
Hehe, turned out great after all.
Mmm... I'll have to do better next time.
It definitely lived up to the hype. That was delicious♪
Somehow... it wasn't as good as I'd hoped.
It was decent enough, I suppose.
